transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I... well, they told me I had to come. At work. I'm a cashier, and... I guess I've been doing things that hold up the line. Like, I'll just start tapping the scanner. In a certain way. Or I'll just stop moving, with my hand hovering over the drawer, and the customer is just... standing there. I got written up for it last week.
When you find yourself tapping the scanner or freezing like that, what is going through your mind?
I don't know. Nothing, really. I just... I just have to do it. It's not like I'm thinking about anything in particular. I just get stuck.
